channel.title: PDFTrail Blog
channel.description: Field guides on getting data out of PDFs on a Mac — without uploading anything anywhere.

item.title: PDFTrail 1.2: Real Excel Tables from Scanned Pages
item.description: What shipped in 1.2 — scanned tables shaped like the page, images inside text PDFs, 10 free exports — and how the r/macapps launch thread shaped it.

item.title: Before and After: Teaching Our Engine to Read Bad Scans
item.description: We fed our engine the worst scans we could find. It invented 26 tables that didn't exist. Here's how that number became zero, and stays there.

item.title: How to Convert a Bank Statement PDF to Excel on Mac
item.description: Retyping is slow, copy-paste collapses the columns, and online converters want you to upload the one document you never should. The three real options on a Mac, and a step-by-step walkthrough of the on-device one.
